entities.name: Vampires
entities.description: Creatures that subsist by feeding on the blood or life force of others, found on many planes in varied forms.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The Alaran shard where rare vampires fed on zombies and held annual meetings at Unx.

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: Founder and head of the Maestros of New Capenna and its first vampire.

entities.name: Evelyn
entities.description: Xander's first progeny among the vampires of New Capenna.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: A vampire of the Maestros who was granted vampirism by Xander and is Errant's father.

entities.name: Errant
entities.description: Anhelo's biological daughter, a human rather than a vampire.

entities.name: Parnesse
entities.description: A vampire who is Errant's wife and Anhelo's daughter-in-law and who can view herself with an Obscura device.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: The New Capenna crime family that many vampires belong to.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: A legendary baron of Dominaria and Ulgrotha from whom the Sengir vampires descend.

entities.name: Garza Zol
entities.description: The queen of the Krovikan vampires of Krov during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: The alchemist of Stensia who underwent a blood ritual, thereby founding Innistrad's vampires.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where vampiric bloodlines govern Stensia.

entities.name: Markov
entities.description: A major Innistrad vampire bloodline that suffered great losses when Nahiri trapped its members in stone.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: A major vampire bloodline of Innistrad that largely fell to Emrakul's corruption.

entities.name: Stromkirk
entities.description: A major vampire bloodline of Innistrad that largely fell to Emrakul's corruption.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan whose corruption ravaged the Falkenrath and Stromkirk bloodlines.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: The lithomancer who destroyed Markov Manor, trapping its inhabitants in stone, and who enforced the Eldrazi prison alone.

entities.name: Strefan Maurer
entities.description: The founder of the Maurer bloodline, centered in Stensia's outland valleys.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The mono-white vampires of Torrezon who sought the Immortal Sun on Ixalan.

entities.name: Elenda of Garrano
entities.description: The first Ixalan vampire, who allegedly achieved her state through a deal with Aclazotz.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The bat god of Ixalan who blesses vampires and makes them vampire-bats.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact stolen from the Legion of Dusk that they hope will grant immortality without drinking blood.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A warlord of Mirrodin who kept a Mephidross Vampire as bodyguard and later created a new vampire from Yert.

entities.name: Yert
entities.description: A Moriok made into a vampire by Geth who became the Mephidross's prime predator.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Who defeated Geth's Mephidross Vampire bodyguard.

entities.name: Vraan
entities.description: The Thane of Blood who leads the Bleak Coven of the Rey-Goor.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: The first mind drinker vampire, of House Dimir.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose vampires learn to drink thoughts and memories.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose lower ranks are blood-drinker vampires.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who created progeny on Tarkir while searching for Ugin.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The spirit dragon whom Sorin sought on Tarkir; his hedron cocoon was broken with sacrificed vampire spawn.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan who made Zendikari cultists into the first bloodchiefs and enslaved the vampires.

entities.name: Bloodchiefs
entities.description: The twelve surviving cultists transformed by Ulamog's spawn who became the progenitors of Zendikari vampires.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: Head of the Kalastria vampire family and the only survivor of the first generation of vampires on Zendikar.

entities.name: Kalitas
entities.description: The head of the Ghet family who threatened to enthrall Malakir's vampires to the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: The vampire city on Guul Draz, divided among five families.

entities.name: Susurians
entities.description: Vampires of the Edge who devour matter itself and founded the faith of Monoism.

events.summary: Edgar Markov undergoes a blood ritual during a famine, giving birth to vampires on Innistrad.
events.quote: Thus were vampires born on Innistrad.

events.summary: Xander founds the Maestros and becomes New Capenna's first vampire, siring Evelyn and Anhelo.
events.quote: Xander, founder and head of the Maestros, was the first vampire, and his first progeny was Evelyn .

events.summary: Emrakul's corruption devastates the Falkenrath and Stromkirk bloodlines.
events.quote: The Falkenrath and Stromkirk largely fell victim to Emrakul 's corruption.

events.summary: Nahiri destroys Markov Manor, trapping its inhabitants in stone.
events.quote: The Markov suffered great losses when the lithomancer Nahiri destroyed Markov Manor, trapping its inhabitants in stone.

events.summary: Geth creates a new vampire from Yert after Glissa defeats his bodyguard.
events.quote: Geth created a new vampire from a Moriok named Yert

events.summary: Ulamog's infection transforms twelve Zendikari cultists into the first vampire bloodchiefs.
events.quote: those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire species

events.summary: Nahiri enforces the Eldrazi prison alone, freeing the vampires from Ulamog's yoke.
events.quote: The vampires remained, now free of Ulamog's yoke.

events.summary: Zendikari vampires fall into civil war as the Eldrazi escape; the Ghet seize holdings and Drana retakes Malakir before being driven out.
events.quote: Drana struck back, retaking control of Malakir and driving Kalitas and his traitors away from the city.

events.summary: Sorin's vampire progeny on Tarkir are sacrificed in the new timeline to break Ugin's cocoon.
events.quote: in the new timeline, they were sacrificed to break Ugin's hedron cocoon
